name: Nuckolls County, NE
findings: Nuckolls County has 32 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Nuckolls County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Nuckolls County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
